# EnvSift

> Private, browser-only tools for comparing, inspecting, formatting, merging, redacting, and converting environment variable files.

EnvSift processes all pasted and local file content inside the user's browser. It does not upload, store, or include ENV contents, keys, values, or filenames in analytics.

## Tools

- [ENV Compare](https://envsift.damnlabs.com/compare): Find missing and changed variables across two or more environments.
- [.env.example Generator](https://envsift.damnlabs.com/example): Remove values and create a safe template.
- [ENV Inspector](https://envsift.damnlabs.com/inspect): Detect invalid lines, duplicate keys, empty values, missing references, and risky whitespace.
- [Merge and Clean](https://envsift.damnlabs.com/merge): Combine ENV files with explicit conflict resolution and stable ordering.
- [ENV Formatter](https://envsift.damnlabs.com/format): Normalize quotes, ordering, comments, and duplicate assignments.
- [Format Converter](https://envsift.damnlabs.com/convert): Convert ENV or flat JSON to ENV, JSON, shell exports, or Docker Compose syntax.

## Project

- [EnvSift](https://envsift.damnlabs.com): Open the web application.
- [Source code](https://github.com/pixelactstudio/envsift): Review the implementation, documentation, and license.
